scope: General-purpose offline document OCR and synthetic inference research.
conclusions: Lightweight model selection produced the largest observed standalone OCR performance improvement.
Gaussian preprocessing is a provisional candidate based on normalized accuracy and measured latency.
ONNX Runtime CPU and OpenVINO CPU/GPU execution have been demonstrated.
Synthetic runtime results do not establish actual OCR runtime performance.
limitations: Repeated runs are not independent documents.
Actual OCR model conversion remains unresolved.
No controlled C++ versus Python benchmark.
Fixed benchmark order may affect timing.
production_decision: Defer final runtime and language selection until representative models and production requirements have been independently validated.
